step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts an emergency accident detection and response system built on AWS. 1. Vehicle telematics data flows from the retrofit car device (UserConsumerIOT) into AWS IoT Core. 2. AWS IoT Core triggers an AWS Lambda function. 3. The Lambda function initiates Amazon Connect for immediate communication and invokes AWS Step Functions for orchestration. 4. Amazon Connect reaches out to the human Agent (UserCompanyAgent), the vehicle directly (UserConsumerIOT), and the driver on their phone (UserConsumerWebMobile). 5. Customer voice interactions handled by Amazon Lex feed response details into AWS Step Functions to trigger appropriate workflows. 6. DynamoDB, an additional Lambda function, and Amazon Rekognition icons are present on the whiteboard representing video analysis and report storage.
